members.docstring: Check source bytes and audit metadata; this does not verify any theorem.

Exact bounds for an explicitly defined smooth periodic K=8 profile family.

This checks the rational parts of L021. The cutoff and bumps are defined
analytically in that proof; their integrals need not be rounded to create
the exact family. This is NOT a finite-amplitude formation root or a PDE.

Exact integer Bernstein root isolation for the filtered leading profile.

The only approximate values printed are display values. Certificates use
integers and dyadic intervals. This certifies J's root structure, not a PDE.

These checks validate the analytical implication, not the presence of an
actual finite-amplitude root or the choice of its incoming cone.
